_comment: EDIT ME: add or remove testimonial objects. rating is out of 5.

testimonials.quote: Cedarville has been a blessing to our family. The teachers genuinely care about each child's development, and we've seen incredible growth in our daughter's confidence and social skills.
testimonials.author: Mrs. Adebayo Olamide

testimonials.quote: The best decision we made was enrolling our twins at Cedarville. The small class sizes mean they get individual attention, and the daily photo updates give us peace of mind.
testimonials.author: Mr. & Mrs. Chukwu

testimonials.quote: My son started creche at Cedarville and is now in Primary 3. The foundation they gave him in reading and maths has made him excel. Thank you, Cedarville!
testimonials.author: Mrs. Fatima Ibrahim

testimonials.quote: From the warm welcome at the gate every morning to the detailed end-of-term reports, Cedarville feels like an extension of our family. Our daughter genuinely looks forward to school.
testimonials.author: Mr. Emeka Nwosu
